The Perceptual Quality Auditor's 'null' finding contradicts the visual evidence of softness/blur, likely due to its focus on compression noise rather than generative smoothness. I am upgrading the artifact severity because the lack of sharp anatomical boundaries (indicated by pose failure) is a structural defect in clarity.
